title: automate KMS/HSM TLS + key rotation (Vault + SealedSecrets) for private-installer (Helm + Terraform)
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: private deployments require automated rotation of TLS certificates and KMS keys (including HSM-backed keys) and a secure workflow for storing secrets (SealedSecrets + Vault). This PR implements end-to-end automation across the private-installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules to: 1) provision HSM-backed KMS aliases where available, 2) wire Vault transit/PKI integration for certificate issuance/rotation, 3) enable SealedSecrets controller to decrypt secrets via Vault when running in air-gapped or VPC deployments, 4) add a controller/cronjob to perform rolling TLS certificate rotation with preflight validation and graceful rollout/rollback hooks, and 5) expose opt-in terraform variables and helm values to allow customers to pin key providers and rotation windows.  What this PR includes: - Terraform: new module redwood_kms with support for HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM or external HSM vendor), key rotation schedule resource, IAM roles for KMS usage, and example usage in private-installer/terraform/overlays. - Helm: chart changes to private-installer chart: templates/secret-controller (init-container for sealed-secrets bootstrap), templates/cert-rotator (cronjob + preflight probe), values.yaml additions for kmsProvider/vault config and hsm options. - Installer: private control plane changes to include a bootstrap job that seeds Vault with CA, generates CSR, and stores SealedSecret keys; upgrade/rollback hooks to ensure cert chains are validated before switching traffic. - Vault integration: added transit and pki examples, a helper script (scripts/vault-bootstrap.sh) that runs in installer job and supports both sealed-secrets and sealed-secrets-v2 compatibility. - E2E and upgrade tests: new integration tests under test/upgrade that validate idempotent rotation, canary rollout, and ability to rollback when a rotation fails. Checklist: - [x] Terraform validate/plan for example overlay - [x] Helm lint and template smoke tests - [x] Integration test for rotation happy path - [x] Documentation updates (README + upgrade notes) - [x] Security review (SEC-129) Notes on compatibility and migration: - Default behavior is opt-in. Existing installs will be unaffected unless values/vars are changed. - For customers using external HSM, there are vendor-specific parameters; the module exposes a passthrough map to avoid coupling. - SealedSecrets fallback: if Vault is not available, the system falls back to existing sealed-secrets using local keys (controlled by helm value sealedSecrets.useVault). Related: ENG-4273 (KMS/HSM infra), SUP-881 (customer request to automate TLS rotation for on-prem), SEC-129 (security review).
